questions.text:
Read the passage given below.

1. It is an indisputable fact that the world has gone too far with the innovation of new technologies such as mobile phones, the internet and so on, due to which people can tour the cosmos virtually while sitting in one place using their smart devices or other technological gadgets. Though mobile internet access is often hurried and short, it can still provide common internet features like alerts, other data, emails, search engines, instant messages, and game and music downloading.

2. Due to the easy access to smartphones, communication has been very effective and instant. People can convey their message all around the globe to their loved ones without spending hefty sums of money. Adults are always fond of such gadgets and they always welcome and adopt such new technology readily. Further, young people have been able to broaden their minds and improve their skills by researching on the Internet. For instance, they use smartphones to look up any new word they come across. As we know most of universities have online teaching provisions and smartphones assist students in completing their assignments on time.

3. The mobile phone has been a lifesaver for a lot of people in case of an emergency. Likewise, the use of smartphones can be of vital importance in preventing crimes in society by providing information to the security forces in time.

4. Nonetheless, for the young, the use of a mobile phone can be like an addiction and they can misuse it. Young people are also prone to getting involved in undesirable activities on the Internet. This might have an adverse effect on their academic performance. Therefore, young people should always be monitored and made aware of their bad outcomes.

5. Also, a major contributor to its popularity is the availability of prepaid or pay-as-you-go services from a phone shop or an online store. This allows subscribers to load text or airtime credits to their handsets by the use of their credit cards, debit cards or by buying a prepaid card from the network they subscribe to. This plan also doesn't commit a particular customer to a contract. If a prepaid card is not that appealing to you, then you can opt to subscribe using the pay-by-month plan.

Answer the following questions:

subparts.text: In paragraph 1, what does the phrase 'people can tour the cosmos virtually while sitting in one place' suggest about technology?
subparts.answer: It suggests that technology allows people to explore and learn about the world without needing to physically travel.

questions.text:
Read the following passage carefully:

1. Silk is a natural protein fibre, some forms of which can be woven into textiles. Silk has a long history in India. It is known as Resham in eastern and northern India, and Pattu in the southern parts of India. India is the second largest producer of silk in the world after China.

2. Silk is renowned for its luxurious qualities with a natural soft and smooth texture that feels comfortable on the skin. One of its unique qualities is to absorb and release moisture, regulating the body temperature, and keeping the wearer cool and dry.

3. Silk is one of the strongest natural fibres, but it loses up to 20% of its strength when wet. Its elasticity is moderate to poor: if elongated even a small amount, it remains stretched. It can be weakened if exposed to too much sunlight. It may also be attacked by insects, especially if left dirty.

4. The process of silk production is known as sericulture. Silk is produced by several insects; but, generally, only the silk of moth caterpillars has been used for textile manufacturing. To produce 1 kg of silk, 104 kg of mulberry leaves must be eaten by 3000 silkworms.

5. So what makes silk so costly? Firstly, cultivation of silk is a labour-intensive work. Secondly, the silk fabric is carefully derived from the larva of the silkworms which spin silk threads around themselves to make cocoons from natural sources. This makes the production limited due to factors like - climate, availability of quality mulberry leaves and time required by silkworms to complete their lifecycle. Thirdly, the intensive work can only be carried out with specialized knowledge and expertise by skilled artisans and craftsmanship. Lastly, superior quality silk fabrics are made from long and uniform silk fibres giving them a smooth and lustrous appearance. Thus, production requires careful selection, adding to the cost.

In 2021, Karnataka was the highest producer of raw silk at 8483 metric tonnes followed by Andhra Pradesh at 5520 metric tonnes with Assam close behind at 5038 metric tonnes. At the other end of the spectrum there was Chhattisgarh (248 metric tonnes), Nagaland (230 metric tonnes) and UP trailed behind at 179 metric tonnes.

Answer the following questions, based on the above passage:

subparts.text: What does the phrase 'luxurious qualities' in paragraph (2) tell you about the silk fabric? Write in 40 words with evidence from the text.
subparts.answer: Evidence from the text: soft and smooth texture; feels comfortable on skin; absorbs and releases moisture (regulating body temperature).

subparts.text:
Select the option that is true for the assertion and reason given below.

options: (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion.
(B) Both the assertion and the reason are true, but the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion.
(C) The assertion is true, but the reason is false.
(D) The assertion is false, but the reason is true.
subparts.answer: (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason is the correct explanation of the assertion.

subparts.text:
Justify the following statement:
Silk whispers luxury! Its price reflects not just its rarity but the value of the meticulous process behind its creation.
subparts.answer: Labour-intensive cultivation; limited production due to natural factors; specialized knowledge and expertise required; careful selection for superior quality.

subparts.text: According to the passage, mention the top two countries that produce silk.
subparts.answer: China and India

subparts.answer: This makes the production limited/cost high/ (any other correct response to be accepted)

subparts.answer: easily damaged as it loses 20% strength when wet / moderate to poor elasticity / weakened when exposed to sunlight / if dirty - attacked by insects

subparts.text: Based on the given text, mention the states which produced the most and the least amount of raw silk in India in the year 2021.
subparts.answer: Karnataka produced the most amount; Uttar Pradesh produced the least amount.

subparts.text:

104 kgs of mulberry leaves eaten by 3000 silkworms results in ________.
subparts.answer: production of 1 kg of silk

subparts.text: With reference to the given passage, give one reason why silk production is considered labour-intensive.
subparts.answer: It requires specialized knowledge/expertise by skilled artisans and craftsmanship.

questions.text: The road that leads to your market is broken and full of potholes. Mosquitoes and flies breed there. Write a letter to the editor of a local newspaper drawing attention of the concerned authorities to get the road repaired. You are P.V. Prabhu/Prabha, 112, Aram Nagar, Delhi.
questions.answer:
P V. Prabha
112, Aram Nagar
Delhi
September 8, 20XX

The Editor
Navbharat Times
New Delhi

Subject: Poor roads and unsanitary conditions in Aram Nagar

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am a resident of Aram Nagar. The roads in our locality are in terrible condition. The potholes and open manholes are like death traps. Parts of the road were dug up for laying cables a while back and have not been repaired since. This has greatly inconvenienced vehicle drivers and pedestrians alike. The pits and stones on the road have caused tyres of vehicles to puncture, leading to falls and accidents.

Stagnant water in the potholes and pits on the road has become a breeding ground for mosquitoes and flies, adding to the woes of the residents. Adding to the misery, huge garbage dumps can be seen lying here and there, giving an open invitation to both accidents and diseases.

The authorities should immediately pay attention towards the problem and roads should be repaired at the earliest under strict supervision so that condition of the roads does not pose any problem further. It is a matter of great concern which needs urgent attention.

Yours sincerely,
P V. Prabha

The Chairman
Sports Authority
Samudrashahar

Thanking you.

Yours truly,

questions.text:
The given double line graph shows the number of different types of books in two libraries. Write an analytical paragraph using the information given in the graph.

(Graph: number of books in Library X and Library Y by type - Fiction, Non-Fiction, Fantasy, Adventure.)
questions.answer:
The given double line graph shows the number of different types of books the two different libraries have.
The graph provides information that there are mainly four types of books namely fiction, non fiction, fantasy and adventure, that the libraries X and Y have. Library X has fifteen books of fiction, thirty non-fiction, twenty books of fantasy and the highest number of books it has is of adventure which levels off fifty. It has a lots of books on adventure and a very less number of fiction books.
On the other hand, library Y has 15 more fiction books that is around 30 compared to library X. But it has 10 non-fiction books less than library X. There is a huge difference between the number of fantasy books the two libraries have. Library Y has 45 books whereas library X has only 20 books of fantasy. The data shows that both libraries have same number of books on adventure that numbered 50. It is the only genre that both libraries have in plenty overall. The figures show that both libraries X and Y have a huge demand of books with adventurous stories that is why they have it in plenty which is in equal number in both libraries. But we have seen fantasy books are also in high demand in library Y which can soon equal to adventure books. However, library X has only adventure books in plenty whereas all other books are very less in number comparatively.

or.text:
The given bar graph shows the increasing use of skin care products by men and women over the period of three months. Write an analytical paragraph elaborating the given information in about 100 words:

(Bar graphs: 'Products used by Men' and 'Products used by Women' - Facewash, Toner, Sunscreen - number of times used in June, July and August.)
or.answer:
The provided bar graph illustrates the upward trend in the usage of skincare products by both men and women over three months. The graph depicts the growth in the percentage of individuals using these products during the given period. As evident from the data, there has been a significant increase in the adoption of skincare products by both genders. This rise may be attributed to various factors, such as growing awareness of skincare benefits, changing societal norms regarding grooming, and increased marketing efforts by the cosmetic industry.
In June, facewash emerged as the most commonly used skincare product for both genders, with men utilizing it around 35 times and women 25 times during the month. However, there were notable disparities between the genders in their use of toner and sunscreen. Women incorporated toner into their skincare routine more frequently than men, whereas men were observed to use sunscreen more often compared to women. This data suggests that facewash holds universal appeal, being a preferred choice for both men and women. On the other hand, toner and sunscreen seem to cater to specific gender preferences, with women prioritizing toner and men emphasizing the importance of sunscreen in their skincare regimen.

subparts.text: We are often over-indulgent towards people we care about. Explain with reference to the context of the story A Triumph of Surgery.
subparts.answer: In "A Triumph of Surgery," Mrs. Pumphrey's over-indulgence towards Tricki Woo stems from her deep affection for him. For the first time, she feels loved, encouraged, and hopeful about her future. Education opens a new path for her, replacing fear and humiliation with dignity and courage.

questions.text:
Answer ANY ONE of the following two questions, in about 100-120 words

i. Motivation plays an important role in taking risks in life and in succeeding. Do you agree? Discuss with reference to the pilot of the old Dakota and the young seagull.
questions.answer: Motivation is essential when taking chances in life. Every courageous deed is driven by the desire to achieve something extraordinary. This willingness to accept risks motivates one to succeed. The stories "His First Flight" and "The Black Aeroplane" emphasise that success requires taking risks. Even though some choices seem risky, they must be made. The inexperienced pilot and the young seagull make difficult choices but eventually succeed. The seagull made a risky choice because he unexpectedly fell off the ledge while attempting to snag the fish from his mother's beak. He might have had a tragic ending if he hadn't found the courage to spread his wings. The pilot made a risky choice by flying into stormy, dark clouds without sufficient information. The young seagull and the pilot shared a desire to succeed by taking chances. While the pilot's choice was influenced by his circumstances, the young seagull was driven or motivated by his hunger. He was forced to get home to spend time with his family and eat a hearty English breakfast. But once they both decided to succeed, there was no turning back. Finally, the theme of courage brought the flight of the bird and the flight of the human together.

Write a speech, for your classmates, expressing your belief/s with respect to the poem.
or.answer:
A very good morning, to each and everyone present in this room. Today I'm here to express my beliefs with respect to the poem 'Fire and Ice'. Dear friends, I strongly believe that 'Fire and Ice' in Mankind can be addressed to create a harmonious world.
We, humans are swaying between two extremes 'Fire and Ice'. Sometimes we are torn by our unbridled fire of passions, desires, lusts, longings and fury. This further results in greed, avarice and passionate love. All such extreme can lead to conflicts and disasters. If not controlled, they can help in bringing an early end of the world. Humanity can redeem itself and possibly save or delay the end of the world by giving up such extremes of thinking and behaviour.
So let us keep burning the fire of patriotism, solidarity and sensitivity and put ice on indifference and rigidity to create a harmonious world around us.

questions.note: Alternative i covers 'The Black Aeroplane' and 'His First Flight' (both in Ch03_Two_Stories_about_Flying); alternative ii is Ch20_Fire_and_Ice.

questions.text:
Answer ANY ONE of the following two questions, in about 100-120 words.

i. Your teacher conducted an Turn Tables in class, and asked you to put forth your views on Frugality in Life is the Ideal Way to Live.
Write the debate script with points to supplement your stand, both for and against the motion and conclude with your own views. Answer in the context of the lesson The Necklace.
questions.answer:
For the motion
You may begin like this...
Being frugal is the quality of a prudent person who is economical in the consumption of resources available to him. These resources can be in any form be it food, clothes money or just about anything. Avoiding wastage of any kind is the greatest virtue of man. We should always remember that resources available to us by mother earth are scanty, we should make judicious use of them. Today, the whole world is hit by deadly Corona, people are out of jobs, some are working from home, some are doing nothing. In such a scenario the prudent use of money becomes all the more important. So, always use money wisely.
Against the motion,
There are no two ways about it that money makes the world go round. It's the power of money that rules the world in today's time. The more we flaunt it, the more progressive we are thought to be. Everybody loves to possess it. So, if we have more why not just show it. After all being thrifty always doesn't pay, one needs to look for one's own comfort as well. Spend what you have today, do not bother for tomorrow. For no one knows what tomorrow has in store for us.

or.text: ii. How did Hari Singh meet Anil? Why did Anil forgive Hari Singh and promise to pay him regularly? (The Thief's Story)
or.answer: Hari Singh, a fifteen-year-old experienced thief who had changed homes and names, met Anil during a wrestling match. Anil, a kind and simple man, appeared easy-going to Hari Singh, which made the young thief feel comfortable in his presence. Fascinated by Anil's warmth and generosity, Hari Singh expressed his wish to work for him, seeing an opportunity for shelter, food, and guidance. Despite later discovering that Hari Singh had stolen a bundle of money, Anil did not reprimand him or involve the police. Instead, he forgave Hari Singh, showing remarkable understanding and kindness. He even promised to pay him a regular salary, treating him with respect and trust. This act of forgiveness and encouragement allowed Hari Singh to appreciate Anil's generosity and inspired his moral awakening, prompting him to seek redemption.
